page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c10g1.20xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for highly parallel computing workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 82 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 336 GB of system memory, providing approximately 4.1 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The primary feature of this instance is its acceleration hardware, which consists of eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs providing a combined total of 128 GB of VRAM. This multi-GPU configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 35 Gbps to support distributed training and data transfer. However, a notable hardware tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, meaning all data persistence must rely on external block storage or network-attached storage systems.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile tailored for enterprise-scale parallel processing. The inclusion of eight dedicated GPUs and 82 physical CPU cores positions it as a premium resource, suitable for workloads where massive parallel throughput justifies the infrastructure cost. Appropriate workloads include deep learning model training, large-scale scientific simulations, high-performance computing tasks, and complex rendering pipelines.
